purpose: Bitwise repeatability of the sdpa-flash attention backend on B300 (sm_103) under hypertrain.trainer determinism settings (use_deterministic_algorithms=True); companion of attn_qualify_sm120.json, a separate replay domain
driver: 595.91.07 on every GPU of both hosts (host_probe.json / nvidia-smi.csv of each host)
code: hypertrain checkout df6fe60d bind-mounted read-only over the image package (PYTHONPATH=/opt/ht/src); trainer/attention.py at that commit
arch_list_note: torch.cuda.get_arch_list() has no sm_103 (sm_75..sm_100, sm_120) on both hosts; that the cc 10.3 GPUs run the sm_100 cubins is an inference, not measured
method: Fresh process per run (8 runs: hostA GPU 4, hostA GPU 5, hostA GPU 6, hostA GPU 7, hostB GPU 4, hostB GPU 5, hostB GPU 6, hostB GPU 7; 2 AWS hosts with 8 B300 each), 3 in-process repeats each, seed 0 (cuda Generator), loss=sum(o.float()^2); one sha256 over the concatenated raw bytes of out,dq,dk,dv. max_abs_err_vs_math compares the forward output only. peak_mib of sdpa-flash includes the math reference output still held. Timing = mean of 10 fwd+bwd (no hashing) after 3 warmups, on hosts shared with other S3 jobs; the 1b math timing (~245 ms vs 41-56 ms on sm_120) is unexplained and is not a B300 math benchmark. GPU N = CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=N (CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER unset). sdpa-flash path chosen: flash. Script: livrables/forge/2026-10-26_qualif-b300/tools/attn_qualify.py (mining sprint S3, 2026-10-26).

candidate.criterion: cross_process_equal on every shape, the sm_120 record's criterion

table_entry: none: QUALIFIED_BACKENDS (trainer/attention.py) has no (10, 3) entry, select_backend returns math on B300 and runs force HT_ATTN_BACKEND=sdpa-flash; adding the entry is Forge's decision
